records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased by $3.5 million, or 3%, during the three months ended September 30, 2021, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2020, primarily due to higher demand within the electrical market that was negatively impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic in the prior year and new business in the general industrial market.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: While managing decreased demand in many regions across the globe, we are now operating at all of our business locations.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: We have been increasing our inventories in the current year to mitigate the risk of supply chain disruption for our customers.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The Series D Preferred Stock has an initial liquidation preference of $1,000 per share and is redeemable at our option in cash at a redemption price equal to the liquidation preference then in effect.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The interest rate swap, which has been designated as a cash flow hedge, has a notional amount of $60.0 million and a maturity date of July 31, 2024.
